say.definition:
n. the chance to speak
v. communicate or express nonverbally
v. utter aloud
v. state as one's opinion or judgement; declare
say.translation:
vt. 说, 讲, 念, 说明, 指明
vi. 说, 讲
n. 意见, 发言权

say about.translation: [法] 估计, 大约, 未定的数量

say cheese.translation: （摄影者鼓励被拍者笑时说的）笑一笑

say hello to.translation: 向某人问候,和某人打招唿

say nay to sth.translation: 拒绝某事, 不批准某事

say sth in blame of sb.word: say sth in blame of sb

say turkey to one and bazzard to another.word: say turkey to one and bazzard to another
